calendar_events_times_chk.name: calendar_events_times_chk
calendar_events_times_chk.value: "calendar_events"."start_time" IS NULL OR "calendar_events"."end_time" IS NULL OR "calendar_events"."end_time" > "calendar_events"."start_time"

exams_dates_chk.name: exams_dates_chk
exams_dates_chk.value: "exams"."start_date" IS NULL OR "exams"."end_date" IS NULL OR "exams"."end_date" >= "exams"."start_date"

exam_papers_times_chk.name: exam_papers_times_chk
exam_papers_times_chk.value: "exam_papers"."start_time" IS NULL OR "exam_papers"."end_time" IS NULL OR "exam_papers"."end_time" > "exam_papers"."start_time"

exam_papers_marks_chk.name: exam_papers_marks_chk
exam_papers_marks_chk.value:
("exam_papers"."grading_type" = 'MARKS' AND "exam_papers"."max_marks" > 0 AND ("exam_papers"."pass_marks" IS NULL OR "exam_papers"."pass_marks" BETWEEN 0 AND "exam_papers"."max_marks"))
        OR ("exam_papers"."grading_type" = 'GRADE' AND "exam_papers"."max_marks" IS NULL AND "exam_papers"."pass_marks" IS NULL)

result_publications_exam_current_uq.name: result_publications_exam_current_uq
result_publications_exam_current_uq.where: "result_publications"."exam_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "result_publications"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL

result_publications_scheme_current_uq.name: result_publications_scheme_current_uq
result_publications_scheme_current_uq.where: "result_publications"."scheme_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "result_publications"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL

result_publications_source_chk.name: result_publications_source_chk
result_publications_source_chk.value:
("result_publications"."kind" = 'EXAM' AND "result_publications"."exam_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."scheme_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("result_publications"."kind" = 'SCHEME' AND "result_publications"."scheme_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_publications"."exam_id" IS NULL)

result_policies_percent_chk.name: result_policies_percent_chk
result_policies_percent_chk.value:
("result_policies"."subject_min_percent" IS NULL OR "result_policies"."subject_min_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
        AND ("result_policies"."overall_min_percent" IS NULL OR "result_policies"."overall_min_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

result_policy_assignments_exam_class_uq.name: result_policy_assignments_exam_class_uq
result_policy_assignments_exam_class_uq.where: "result_policy_assignments"."exam_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_policy_assignments"."class_id" IS NOT NULL AND "result_policy_assignments"."is_active" = true

result_policy_assignments_target_chk.name: result_policy_assignments_target_chk
result_policy_assignments_target_chk.value: "result_policy_assignments"."exam_id" IS NOT NULL OR "result_policy_assignments"."class_id" IS NOT NULL

sections_deputy_class_teacher_chk.name: sections_deputy_class_teacher_chk
sections_deputy_class_teacher_chk.value: "sections"."deputy_class_teacher_id" IS NULL OR "sections"."class_teacher_id" IS NULL OR "sections"."deputy_class_teacher_id" <> "sections"."class_teacher_id"

substitutions_kind_chk.name: substitutions_kind_chk
substitutions_kind_chk.value:
CASE "substitutions"."kind"
        WHEN 'SUBSTITUTE' THEN "substitutions"."substitute_teacher_id" IS NOT NULL AND "substitutions"."activity" IS NULL
        WHEN 'ACTIVITY' THEN "substitutions"."activity" IS NOT NULL AND "substitutions"."subject_id" IS NULL
        ELSE "substitutions"."substitute_teacher_id" IS NULL AND "substitutions"."subject_id" IS NULL AND "substitutions"."activity" IS NULL
      END

access_assignments_dates_chk.name: access_assignments_dates_chk
access_assignments_dates_chk.value: "access_assignments"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "access_assignments"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "access_assignments"."valid_to" >= "access_assignments"."valid_from"

access_assignments_revoked_chk.name: access_assignments_revoked_chk
access_assignments_revoked_chk.value: "access_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NULL OR "access_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

access_assignments_revoke_reason_chk.name: access_assignments_revoke_reason_chk
access_assignments_revoke_reason_chk.value: "access_assignments"."revoke_reason" IS NULL OR "access_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

student_credit_entries_chk.name: student_credit_entries_chk
student_credit_entries_chk.value: "student_credit_entries"."amount" > 0 AND ("student_credit_entries"."entry_type" <> 'OVERPAYMENT' OR "student_credit_entries"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("student_credit_entries"."entry_type" <> 'APPLIED' OR "student_credit_entries"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL)

late_fee_rules_chk.name: late_fee_rules_chk
late_fee_rules_chk.value: "late_fee_rules"."grace_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND ("late_fee_rules"."max_amount" IS NULL OR "late_fee_rules"."max_amount" > 0)

ledger_accounts_system_key_uq.name: ledger_accounts_system_key_uq
ledger_accounts_system_key_uq.where: "ledger_accounts"."system_key" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."fee_head_id" IS NULL

payment_refunds_gateway_chk.name: payment_refunds_gateway_chk
payment_refunds_gateway_chk.value: "payment_refunds"."method" <> 'ORIGINAL' OR "payment_refunds"."status"::text IN ('REQUESTED', 'REJECTED') OR "payment_refunds"."gateway_refund_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_refunds_approval_chk.name: payment_refunds_approval_chk
payment_refunds_approval_chk.value: "payment_refunds"."source" <> 'STAFF' OR "payment_refunds"."status"::text IN ('REQUESTED', 'REJECTED') OR ("payment_refunds"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_refunds"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_refunds_credit_chk.name: payment_refunds_credit_chk
payment_refunds_credit_chk.value: ("payment_refunds"."payment_id" IS NULL) = ("payment_refunds"."invoice_id" IS NULL) AND ("payment_refunds"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("payment_refunds"."source" = 'STAFF' AND "payment_refunds"."method" <> 'ORIGINAL' AND "payment_refunds"."from_invoice" = 0))

payment_refunds_rejection_chk.name: payment_refunds_rejection_chk
payment_refunds_rejection_chk.value: ("payment_refunds"."status"::text = 'REJECTED') = ("payment_refunds"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("payment_refunds"."rejected_at" IS NULL OR ("payment_refunds"."rejected_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_refunds"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL))

hostel_allocations_cancelled_chk.name: hostel_allocations_cancelled_chk
hostel_allocations_cancelled_chk.value: "hostel_allocations"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' OR ("hostel_allocations"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "hostel_allocations"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

hostel_resource_assignments_cancelled_ch.name: hostel_resource_assignments_cancelled_chk
hostel_resource_assignments_cancelled_ch.value: "hostel_resource_assignments"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' OR ("hostel_resource_assignments"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "hostel_resource_assignments"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

staff_attendance_times_chk.name: staff_attendance_times_chk
staff_attendance_times_chk.value: "staff_attendance"."check_in" IS NULL OR "staff_attendance"."check_out" IS NULL OR "staff_attendance"."check_out" >= "staff_attendance"."check_in"

stock_movements_direction_chk.name: stock_movements_direction_chk
stock_movements_direction_chk.value:
("stock_movements"."type" IN ('RECEIPT', 'RETURN') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_change" > 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'ISSUE' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_change" < 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_change" <> 0)

library_circulation_rules_role_type_uq.name: library_circulation_rules_role_type_uq
library_circulation_rules_role_type_uq.where: "library_circulation_rules"."is_active" = true AND "library_circulation_rules"."borrower_role" IS NOT NULL AND "library_circulation_rules"."item_type" IS NOT NULL

library_circulation_rules_role_uq.name: library_circulation_rules_role_uq
library_circulation_rules_role_uq.where: "library_circulation_rules"."is_active" = true AND "library_circulation_rules"."borrower_role" IS NOT NULL AND "library_circulation_rules"."item_type" IS NULL

library_circulation_rules_type_uq.name: library_circulation_rules_type_uq
library_circulation_rules_type_uq.where: "library_circulation_rules"."is_active" = true AND "library_circulation_rules"."borrower_role" IS NULL AND "library_circulation_rules"."item_type" IS NOT NULL

library_circulation_rules_any_uq.name: library_circulation_rules_any_uq
library_circulation_rules_any_uq.where: "library_circulation_rules"."is_active" = true AND "library_circulation_rules"."borrower_role" IS NULL AND "library_circulation_rules"."item_type" IS NULL

library_circulation_rules_terms_chk.name: library_circulation_rules_terms_chk
library_circulation_rules_terms_chk.value: "library_circulation_rules"."loan_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365 AND "library_circulation_rules"."max_loans" >= 0 AND "library_circulation_rules"."max_renewals" >= 0 AND "library_circulation_rules"."fine_per_day" >= 0 AND "library_circulation_rules"."fine_grace_days" >= 0 AND ("library_circulation_rules"."max_fine" IS NULL OR "library_circulation_rules"."max_fine" >= 0)

library_holds_ready_chk.name: library_holds_ready_chk
library_holds_ready_chk.value: ("library_holds"."status" <> 'WAITING' OR ("library_holds"."copy_id" IS NULL AND "library_holds"."ready_on" IS NULL AND "library_holds"."pickup_by" IS NULL)) AND ("library_holds"."status" <> 'READY' OR ("library_holds"."copy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "library_holds"."ready_on" IS NOT NULL AND "library_holds"."pickup_by" IS NOT NULL))

generated.as: late_fine + lost_charge + damage_charge - fine_paid - fine_waived + fine_credited

library_loans_lost_chk.name: library_loans_lost_chk
library_loans_lost_chk.value: ("library_loans"."status" = 'LOST') <= ("library_loans"."lost_on" IS NOT NULL) AND ("library_loans"."lost_on" IS NULL OR "library_loans"."status" <> 'ISSUED') AND ("library_loans"."found_on" IS NULL OR ("library_loans"."lost_on" IS NOT NULL AND "library_loans"."status" = 'RETURNED' AND "library_loans"."found_on" >= "library_loans"."lost_on"))

library_loans_fine_chk.name: library_loans_fine_chk
library_loans_fine_chk.value: "library_loans"."late_fine" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."lost_charge" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."damage_charge" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."lost_charge_reversed" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."fine_paid" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."fine_waived" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."fine_credited" >= 0 AND "library_loans"."fine_credited" <= "library_loans"."fine_paid" AND "library_loans"."fine_paid" - "library_loans"."fine_credited" + "library_loans"."fine_waived" <= "library_loans"."late_fine" + "library_loans"."lost_charge" + "library_loans"."damage_charge"

transport_assignments_ended_chk.name: transport_assignments_ended_chk
transport_assignments_ended_chk.value: ("transport_assignments"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "transport_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL) OR ("transport_assignments"."status" = 'ENDED' AND "transport_assignments"."end_date" IS NOT NULL)
